select
, resFile.thumb_nail_url as thumb_nail_url from gc_user_event_resource r left join gc_master_message mm on mm.res_id = r.id and (mm.target_user_id = r.target_user_id or r.target_user_id is null) and mm.target_user_id =#{userId} left join sys_file resFile on r.file_id = resFile.id
left join gc_user thisUser on thisUser.id= r.user_id left join gc_user_info thisUserInfo on thisUserInfo.id=thisUser.info_id left join sys_file thisUserFile on thisUserInfo.avatar_file_id = thisUserFile.id
left join gc_user targetUser on targetUser.id = r.target_user_id left join gc_user_info targetUserInfo on targetUserInfo.id=targetUser.info_id left join sys_file targetUserFile on targetUserInfo.avatar_file_id = targetUserFile.id where event_id = #{eventId} and r.master_id=#{masterId} and (r.user_id = #{userId} or mm.target_user_id = #{userId})
and r.user_id = #{userId}
and mm.target_user_id = #{userId}
and (r.user_id = #{userId} or mm.target_user_id = #{userId})
order by r.update_time desc

select u.id as user_id,ui.id as info_id,ui.first_name,ui.last_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.sub_id in
#{subId}
and ur.type!=${@com.threeatom.guidecore.constant.EventResType@TEXT_0} THEN TRUE END) as uploadResNum from gc_user u LEFT JOIN gc_user_event_resource ur ON u.id=ur.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_event e on ur.event_id=e.id LEFT JOIN gc_video v on e.video_id=v.id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON v.sub_id=s.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui on ui.id=u.info_id WHERE 1=1
AND u.id in
#{userId}
GROUP BY u.id
ORDER BY uploadResNum asc
ORDER BY uploadResNum desc

SELECT e.event_title,vr.user_id,vr.update_time,vr.event_id,ui.id as info_id,ui.first_name,ui.last_name,f2.file_url AS file_url_video,f2.save_type AS save_type_video FROM gc_user_event_resource AS vr LEFT JOIN gc_event AS e ON e.id = vr.event_id LEFT JOIN gc_user AS u ON u.id = vr.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui on ui.id=u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file f2 on ui.avatar_file_id=f2.id WHERE vr.user_id = #{userId} OR vr.target_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY vr.update_time DESC

SELECT vr.id,e.event_title,vr.user_id,vr.update_time,vr.target_user_id,vr.event_id,vr.time_node,vr.target_id,vr.type,vr.content ,ui.id as info_id,ui.first_name,ui.last_name,f2.file_url AS file_url_video,f2.save_type AS save_type_video,v.video_name FROM gc_user_event_resource AS vr LEFT JOIN gc_event AS e ON e.id = vr.event_id LEFT JOIN gc_user AS u ON u.id = vr.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui on ui.id=u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file AS f2 ON f2.id = vr.file_id LEFT JOIN gc_video AS v ON v.id = e.video_id WHERE 1=1
AND vr.event_id IN
#{eventId}
AND (vr.user_id = #{studentId} OR vr.target_user_id = #{studentId}) AND ((vr.type = ${@com.threeatom.guidecore.constant.EventResType@VIDEO_2} and vr.time_node=-1) or vr.time_node!=-1) order by vr.update_time desc

SELECT vr.id, m.id as message_id, m.target_user_id AS m_target_user_id, e.event_title, vr.user_id, vr.content, vr.type, vr.time_node, vr.update_time, vr.target_user_id, vr.target_id, vr.event_id, ui.id as info_id,ui.first_name,ui.last_name, f.file_url, f.save_type, f2.file_url AS file_url_video, f2.save_type AS save_type_video, f2.name AS file_name,m.read_state FROM gc_user_event_resource AS vr LEFT JOIN gc_event AS e ON e.id = vr.event_id LEFT JOIN gc_user AS u ON u.id = vr.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui on ui.id=u.info_id LEFT JOIN sys_file f on ui.avatar_file_id=f.id LEFT JOIN sys_file AS f2 ON f2.id = vr.file_id LEFT JOIN gc_master_message AS m ON m.res_id = vr.id WHERE 1=1
AND vr.event_id IN
#{eventId}
AND ( ( (m.target_user_id = #{teacherId} AND m.user_id = #{studentId}) or vr.user_id = #{studentId} ) OR (m.target_user_id = #{studentId} AND m.user_id = #{teacherId}) )
AND (m.user_id = #{studentId} OR m.target_user_id = #{studentId} OR vr.user_id = #{studentId})
ORDER BY vr.update_time DESC
